name: vslilypond-plus
description: Fork of VSLilyPond: syntax and error highlighting, compilation on save, format on save (bundled python-ly), MIDI input (Dutch or English note names) and playback for LilyPond in VSCode.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Playback: Play (from start)
commands.description: Play MIDI from the start. You can also use the `Play MIDI` button on the left of the status bar. MIDI Playback device is set using `VSLilyPond: MIDI Playback: Set output device` command.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Playback: Play from...
commands.description: Play MIDI from a user-input timestamp. You can also use the `Play MIDI from...` button on the left of the status bar.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Playback: Stop
commands.description: Stop MIDI playback. You can also use the `Stop MIDI` button on the left of the status bar.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Playback: Pause
commands.description: Pause MIDI playback. You can also use the `Pause MIDI` button on the left of the status bar.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Playback: Resume
commands.description: Resume MIDI playback. You can also use the `Play MIDI` button on the left of the status bar.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Playback: Set output device
commands.description: Set workspace-folder specific MIDI output device for playback. You can also change this manually (for more scopes) in settings under `Vslilypond › Midi Playback: Output`.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Input: Start MIDI input
commands.description: Start MIDI Input. You can also use the `Start MIDI Input` button on the right of the status bar. MIDI input device is set using `VSLilyPond: MIDI Playback: Set input device` command.`

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Input: Stop MIDI input
commands.description: Stop MIDI Input. You can also use the `Stop MIDI Input` button on the right of the status bar.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Input: Set input device
commands.description: Set workspace-folder specific MIDI input device for input. You can also change this manually (for more scopes) in settings under `Vslilypond › Midi Input: Input`.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Input: Restart MIDI Input
commands.description: Restart MIDI Input. Try this if the input stops working after changing your MIDI Input device/port.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: Compile
commands.description: Compiles a main lilypond file (if specified in settings). Otherwise, compiles the currently active lilypond file. (Use `VSLilyPond: Compile this specific file` to compile the currently active file). See settings under `Vslilypond › Compilation` for additional settings.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: Compile this specific file
commands.description: Compiles the currently active lilypond file. Use `VSLilyPond: Compile` to compile a main file if specified in settings.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Input: Start/stop MIDI input
commands.description: Start MIDI input if it is stopped, or stop it if it is running.

commands.title: VSLilyPond: MIDI Input: Toggle sharps/flats
commands.description: Switch `vslilypondPlus.midiInput.accidentals` between sharps and flats. Restarts MIDI input if it is running so the change applies immediately.

vslilypondPlus.general.pathToLilypond.description: Path to `lilypond` executable. Default (`lilypond`) assumes lilypond is in PATH variables. Reload required.

vslilypondPlus.intellisense.enabled.description: Displays errors as you type. Disable to improve performance. Reload required.

vslilypondPlus.compilation.compileOnSave.description: Compiles file upon saving. Disable to improve performance. Reload required.

vslilypondPlus.compilation.compileMainFi.description: If true, compiles main file set in `Vslilypond › Compilation › Path To Main Compilation File`, else, compiles the currently active file.

vslilypondPlus.compilation.additionalCom.description: Additional command line arguments supplied to `lilypond` upon compilation. Note that `--loglevel=WARNING` is predefined. Intellisense also uses these arguments.

vslilypondPlus.compilation.pathToMainCom.description: Relative path (from workspace folder root) of the file to compile when a document in a folder/workspace is saved. If none specified, the current active file is compiled.

vslilypondPlus.midiPlayback.output.description: MIDI Device used for output. If none specified, the first valid device is used. You can use the command `VSLilyPond: MIDI Playback: Set output device` to select a device from a list.

vslilypondPlus.midiInput.input.description: MIDI Device used for input. If none specified, the first valid device is used. After changing, please run the `VSLilyPond: MIDI Input: Restart MIDI Input` command. You can alternatively use the command `VSLilyPond: MIDI Input: Set output device` to select a device from a list.

vslilypondPlus.midiInput.chordMode.description: Chord mode in music entry. Registers notes that are pressed and held together as a chord instead of sequential notes.

vslilypondPlus.midiInput.relativeMode.description: Relative mode (as opposed to absolute mode).

enumDescriptions: Dutch note names (`cis`, `bes`): LilyPond's default input language.
English note names (`cs`, `bf`), for files using `\language "english"`.
vslilypondPlus.midiInput.noteNames.description: Note-name language used when MIDI input types notes.

vslilypondPlus.formatting.formatOnSave.description: Reformat LilyPond files with python-ly (`ly reformat`) just before saving. The editor's current text is formatted, so unsaved edits are never lost. If formatting fails the file is saved unformatted.

vslilypondPlus.formatting.pathToPython.description: Path to the Python 3 executable used to run python-ly. Default (`python3`) assumes it is in PATH.

vslilypondPlus.formatting.useBundledPyth.description: Use the copy of python-ly bundled with this extension. Disable to use the python-ly installed for `vslilypondPlus.formatting.pathToPython`.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
